title: The molecular mechanisms underlying anti-inflammatory effects of galangin in different diseases.
authors: Hassanein, Emad H M; Abd El-Maksoud, Mostafa S; Ibrahim, Islam M; Abd-Alhameed, Esraa K; Althagafy, Hanan S; Mohamed, Nesma M; Ross, Samir A
one_liner_zh: 该文综述高良姜素在不同疾病中的抗炎分子机制，仅涉及分子对接验证信号通路，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: When used as an alternative source of drugs to treat inflammation-associated diseases, phytochemicals with anti-inflammatory properties provide beneficial impacts. Galangin is one of the most naturally occurring flavonoids. Galangin has many biological activities, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, antiproliferative, antimicrobial, anti-obesity, antidiabetic, and anti-genotoxic activities. We observed that galangin was well tolerated and positively impacted disease underlying inflammation for the renal, hepatic, central nervous system, cardiovascular, gastrointestinal system, skin, and respiratory disorders, as well as ulcerative colitis, acute pancreatitis, retinopathy, osteoarthritis, osteoporosis, and rheumatoid arthritis. Galangin anti-inflammatory effects are mediated mainly by suppressing p38 mitogen-activated protein kinases, nuclear factor-kappa B, and nod-like receptor protein 3 signals. These effects are confirmed and supported by molecular docking. Clinical translational research is required to accelerate the bench-to-bedside transfer and determine whether galangin can be utilised as a safe, natural source of pharmaceutical anti-inflammatory medication for humans.
abstract_zh: 当用作治疗炎症相关疾病的替代药物来源时，具有抗炎特性的植物化学物质能带来有益影响。高良姜素（Galangin）是最常见的天然黄酮类化合物之一。高良姜素具有多种生物活性，如抗炎、抗氧化、抗增殖、抗菌、抗肥胖、抗糖尿病和抗遗传毒性等活性。我们观察到，高良姜素耐受性良好，并对肾、肝、中枢神经系统、心血管、胃肠系统、皮肤和呼吸系统疾病，以及溃疡性结肠炎、急性胰腺炎、视网膜病变、骨关节炎、骨质疏松症和类风湿关节炎等炎症相关疾病产生积极影响。高良姜素的抗炎作用主要通过抑制p38丝裂原活化蛋白激酶、核因子-κB和NOD样受体蛋白3信号通路来介导。这些效应通过分子对接（molecular docking）得到确认和支持。临床转化研究需加速推进，以促进从实验室到临床的转化，并确定高良姜素能否作为人类安全、天然的药物抗炎来源。
